limitations: Eight images is a diagnostic cohort, not a production-representative or statistically representative sample (D3-R2 section 6, D3-U2).
The 5000 ms admission-time and 256 MiB native-memory targets are observational per D1/D3-R2; this report makes no runtime-enforcement claim.

Native-inclusive memory uses the conservative [L, U] bracket: WITHIN_TARGET requires U <= target, EXCEEDS_TARGET requires L > target, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; no peak-to-peak delta or polling observation is used.
Cohort B reports minimum/median/maximum only; p95 is intentionally never computed from 3 repeats (D3-U2).
